coinSound.author: StarNinjas
coinSound.notes: Actual creator-recorded metal coins, releasedCC0 by StarNinjas. Short coin recording decoded to WAV and linearly normalised to peak0.80; no Nintendo audio or new synthesis. Raw original OGG and source archive preserved. Audibility measured from waveform; live room-speaker audition remains required.
